intro: Twenty-four questions. Each one has an owner and a method, because a question without a way to close it is just a worry. 'Have' means an official source answers it now. 'Don't have' means nothing official answers it and a decision made today would be a guess.

questions.question: Do the five supplied links carry our tracking ID at all?
questions.answer: No. Each short link resolves to an amazon.com/dp/ URL with no tag parameter. Under Program Policies 2(b) the Associates ID must appear as a parameter on every link placed on a site.
questions.consequence: Any traffic sent through the supplied links earns nothing attributable and proves nothing. Nothing on this site links out until this is fixed.
questions.how_to_close: Open Associates Central, click a product through SiteStripe, and read the URL. If it contains tag=shopnow047c-20 the question is closed in one minute.

questions.question: Is shopnow047c-20 an approved tracking ID on this account?
questions.consequence: The build stamps this value into every outbound URL. If it is not a live ID, every link is broken in a way no check on this repository can detect.
questions.how_to_close: Associates Central, Account Settings, Tracking IDs. Screenshot the list.

questions.question: What does link 4 (B0c8moW59) actually point to?
questions.answer: Not determinable. The link lands on a 'Continue shopping' interstitial and a catalog search for the code returns no results.
questions.consequence: Slot 4 is empty on the site. Naming a product for it would mean inventing one.
questions.how_to_close: Re-issue from SiteStripe and confirm the destination loads a detail page.

questions.question: Does the account have API access (PA API or Creators API)?
questions.consequence: Determines whether prices, availability, and ratings can ever appear on the site. Without API access they must not appear at all.
questions.how_to_close: Check Associates Central for API credentials. Record the answer here either way.

questions.question: How many qualifying sales has the account had, and when?
questions.consequence: Amazon's program requires a minimum level of activity to stay enrolled; the exact current threshold must be read from the agreement, not from memory. If the account is dormant, a five-product site will not revive it.
questions.how_to_close: Read the current Commission Income Statement (S02) for the eligibility clause, and export the payment report.

questions.question: Which Amazon marketplace is the audience in?
questions.consequence: All five products are 120 V, US-spec. If the reader is elsewhere, the site is recommending appliances they cannot plug in.
questions.how_to_close: State the intended marketplace. The current build assumes amazon.com and says so in the footer.

questions.question: What is the Associates commission rate for this category, today?
questions.answer: Deliberately not stated. The rate card is behind sign-in (S02 links to a schedule that redirects to a login page) and rates change by category and by month.
questions.consequence: No revenue model is presented anywhere on this site. Any figure a reader sees would be a guess dressed as a fact.
questions.how_to_close: Read the rate card while signed in and record the category rate with the date read.

questions.question: Is there any hands-on testing behind these recommendations?
questions.answer: No. Everything published is sourced from manufacturer specification pages and Amazon listings. No unit was used by anyone writing this site.
questions.consequence: The site must never use first-person testing language. It compares published specifications and states who each model suits. That is a real, useful thing — but it is not a review.
questions.how_to_close: Either fund one unit for testing, or keep the spec-comparison framing permanently and label it as such.

questions.question: Which preset count is correct for the Emeril oven: 24 or 25?
questions.answer: Unresolved. The manufacturer page states both, in a spec tile and in body copy.
questions.consequence: The field is blank. No preset count appears in the copy for that product.
questions.how_to_close: Email manufacturer support and keep the reply. See FLG-001.

questions.question: Is the Chefman 8 Qt 1700 W or 1000 W?
questions.answer: Unresolved. The manufacturer page says 1700 W; the Amazon bullet says 1000 W for the same model number.
questions.consequence: The site uses the manufacturer figure and flags the conflict. It should not be used in an ad claim until confirmed.
questions.how_to_close: Confirm with CHEFMAN support in writing. See FLG-002.

questions.question: What is actually in the box for the Emeril oven now?
questions.answer: Unresolved. The manufacturer says 7 accessories; its own accessory page says the grill plate is no longer included.
questions.consequence: The site does not claim an accessory list. Copy says to check current box contents.
questions.how_to_close: Ask the manufacturer for the current in-box list by model number. See FLG-006.

questions.question: Do we have a privacy policy that covers the analytics endpoint?
questions.consequence: The analytics script deliberately records no identifiers, which makes the policy short — but 'short' is not 'unnecessary'. Program Policies require a compliant privacy disclosure.
questions.how_to_close: Publish a policy that names the endpoint, the five event types, the fields, and the retention period.

questions.question: Where will the analytics endpoint live?
questions.consequence: The script ships with the endpoint unset so it fails open and records nothing. Site works, measurement does not.
questions.how_to_close: Set ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT at build time. See SG-14.

questions.question: Who reads the dashboard, and how often?
questions.consequence: Data nobody reads is a liability with no return.
questions.how_to_close: Name a person and a monthly cadence, or leave analytics off.

questions.question: Is the domain karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil3 the permanent home?
questions.answer: It is where the site is published today, via GitHub Pages from main.
questions.consequence: A github.io subpath is indexable but carries no brand ownership. Moving later means redirects and a temporary ranking reset.
questions.how_to_close: Decide before content volume grows. Record the decision in this file.

questions.question: Has the site been verified in Search Console?
questions.consequence: Without verification there is no impression data, so the 'choose the next topic from measured queries' plan cannot start.
questions.how_to_close: Verify the property per S17 and submit sitemap.xml per S18.

questions.question: Does the site have an authorship signal a reader can evaluate?
questions.answer: Not yet. There is an editorial standards page but no named author with credentials.
questions.consequence: Readers and search quality raters both weigh who is making the claim. 'The editors' is weaker than a name and a method.
questions.how_to_close: Publish a real author bio, or state plainly that the site publishes spec comparisons rather than tests and name the method.

questions.question: What separates this site from the ten air fryer sites already ranking?
questions.consequence: Without an answer the guides compete on volume, which is a race the site loses on day one.
questions.how_to_close: Write one sentence a competitor could not also write. The current candidate: we publish conflicts between official sources instead of picking the friendlier number.

questions.question: Is there budget for the products, or for images?
questions.consequence: Image use is constrained by policy: Amazon product images may not be stored. Manufacturer marketing images have their own terms. The current build uses no product photography and says why.
questions.how_to_close: Decide: no photography (current), licensed photography, or original photography.

questions.question: What is the correction policy when a reader reports an error?
questions.consequence: Without a policy, corrections happen ad hoc and the flag page stops being maintained. That is the point at which the verification advantage quietly disappears.
questions.how_to_close: Adopt SG-09 and publish the log.

questions.question: Do the four resolved products still match the live listings?
questions.answer: Yes as of 2026-11-20. Each was re-resolved and read that day.
questions.consequence: This answer expires. Specs and model numbers change; the access date is on every row for that reason.
questions.how_to_close: Re-run the verification quarterly and update the access dates.

questions.question: Which of the four resolved products is the one to lead with?
questions.answer: The Chefman 6 Qt dual-window: it is the only one of the four with two independent zones and a window on each basket, and its specifications are the least contested across official sources. This is an editorial judgment from published specs, not a sales claim.
questions.consequence: It sits first on the front page. If you disagree, move it and say why.
questions.how_to_close: Confirm or overrule. Either is fine; leaving it unstated is not.

questions.question: Is '25 Qt' or '26 Qt' the model to track for Emeril?
questions.answer: 26 QT. The manufacturer sells 26 QT (4-00675-02A-VN) and a separate 25 QT dual-zone unit (DZEL24 series). These are different appliances and must not be compared as one.
questions.consequence: The register tracks only the 26 QT unit, matching the linked listing.
questions.how_to_close: Closed. Re-check if the linked SKU changes.

questions.question: What happens if the Associates account is not approved for this site?
questions.consequence: A github.io subpath is a site Amazon will review. If it is rejected, every link here becomes a plain link with no commission and the disclosure language becomes inaccurate.
questions.how_to_close: List the site in the Associates account before sending traffic to it. Confirm the site appears as an approved channel.
